documents.name: territories
documents.text: Territories. Sales territories. Territory list. Sales areas. Patches. Coverage areas. Districts. The local areas that sales staff cover, each belonging to a wider region. Contains the territory identifier, the territory description and the region it rolls up into.
Territory ID. Territory identifier. Territory code. Territory number. The code that uniquely identifies a sales territory. Used to link an employee to the territories they cover.

Territory description. Territory name. Name of the territory. Sales area name. District name. What a sales territory is called, usually the town or locality it covers. The readable label of the territory.
Region ID on the territory. Which region a territory belongs to. Region code. Zone the territory rolls up into. Used to link a territory back to its region.
